regressions.explanation: The input identity is unchanged. Post-v0.4.1 experiment commits 048cf07 and 6d789ed froze a strict closed page-global boundary: a selector that still owns active filter controls cannot be relabelled as static page-global content. The predecessor pass was therefore a false-positive pass; the current ScopedSourceContentError is the reviewed fail-closed result.

The input identity is unchanged. Post-v0.4.1 experiment commits 048cf07 and 6d789ed require a declared static page-global selector to be a direct child of the page-level pure-content boundary. This source does not prove that ownership, so replacing the predecessor pass with ScopedSourceContentError is the reviewed fail-closed behavior.

The input identity is unchanged. Post-v0.4.1 experiment commits 048cf07 and 6d789ed require the static page-global range to close at an exact following FAQ/SLA boundary. This source has no such exact boundary, so the predecessor pass is no longer accepted and the current ScopedSourceContentError is intentional.

The source changed from 001d4b0c... to 25ef88c2.... The accepted post-v0.4.1 upstream regression report records that the new source removed the technical-azure-selector/tab container classes and leaves no provable intrinsic Simple business-content boundary. The current ScopedSourceContentError exactly preserves that reviewed fail-closed disposition.

SOURCE_HTML_STRUCTURE_BLOCKED is therefore the expected input-assurance fail-closed result, not an unexplained strategy regression.
